_meta.description: Grouped Process of AGG_WELFORD revenue by quarter of order_date decorated with OVERLAY_T_VS_PRIOR and OVERLAY_Z_VS_PRIOR: each quarter's mean revenue is tested against the quarter before it (Welch t, then the large-sample normal z) from the per-group Welford components {n, mean, variance}. The first quarter has no prior, so its entry carries a null statistic and no p-value; every later quarter carries the statistic (positive when it rose) and its two-sided p. The Holm multiplicity block adjusts the per-quarter p-values within each layer (p_adjusted, significant_adjusted beside the raw p). The tests assume the quarters are independent samples — a panel of the same customers would make the p-values wrong. Buffered: reads Response.Components.
_meta.name: process-t-z-vs-prior
